name: Snapshot required
rule: Every reproducible estimate calculation references a Phase 25 library snapshot or explicit immutable record versions.

name: Direct cost rollup
rule: Direct cost = labor + equipment + fuel where separated + material + subcontract + trucking/haul + disposal + approved direct mobilization/other direct cost.

name: Production duration
rule: Base duration hours = work quantity / production rate when units are compatible; modifiers adjust the governing production or duration according to configured method.

name: Crew labor hours
rule: Labor hours = duration hours × summed crew member counts unless resource scheduling rule specifies otherwise.

name: Equipment hours
rule: Equipment runtime hours derive from equipment participation duration/utilization, not automatically equal to total project duration.

name: Equipment rate selection
rule: Hourly/daily/weekly/monthly equipment rates are selected using configured rental/ownership rate policy; do not linearly infer rates unless policy permits.

name: Fuel quantity
rule: Fuel quantity = configured consumption rate × runtime hours × applicable utilization/load factor when defined.

name: Truck cycle
rule: Truck cycle = load + outbound haul + dump/queue + return + configured delays.

name: Truck count balance
rule: Required truck count is based on loader/source production, truck payload and cycle time, rounded according to configured dispatch policy.

name: Trip count
rule: Trips = haul quantity / effective truck payload, rounded up for discrete loads unless partial-load policy permits otherwise.

name: Haul cost modes
rule: Haul cost supports cycle/trip-based and hourly modes; shortcut methods are not substituted when trip-based calculation is configured.

name: Disposal conversion
rule: Disposal tonnage requires approved density/conversion when source quantity is volumetric.

name: Material quantity
rule: Purchase quantity = installed quantity × (1 + waste factor) unless an approved alternate formula applies.

name: Regional factor
rule: Regional/location factors apply only to configured cost categories and do not double-adjust explicit vendor/custom quotes.

name: Markup sequencing
rule: Markup calculations preserve configured parallel/stacked basis and step order; the engine does not silently change method.

name: O&P trace
rule: Overhead and profit are separate governed components even when presented as a combined percentage.

name: Contingency basis
rule: Contingency basis and exclusions are explicit and versioned.

name: Unit sell price
rule: Unit sell price = sell total / priced quantity for nonzero quantity with controlled rounding.

name: Low/base/high
rule: Low/base/high ranges are scenario outputs from explicit assumptions, not arbitrary percentage padding unless configured.

name: Override audit
rule: Manual overrides require reason, actor, prior value, new value, scope and audit evidence.

name: AI advisory
rule: AI may recommend service mapping, assumptions, risks or crew/equipment alternatives but cannot silently mutate or approve estimate values.

name: Service writeback
rule: A new service created during estimating becomes a Phase 25 writeback proposal/draft through governed approval, not an untracked local label.

name: Estimate freeze
rule: Approved/frozen estimate versions are immutable; revision creates a new version.

name: Calculation trace
rule: Every engine result preserves inputs, formula/rule ID, library versions, units, rounding and output.

name: Job baseline
rule: Job-cost/project handoff references the exact approved estimate version and snapshot.
